scientific.integrity: The branch parameterization and asymptotic saddle proof are analytic. The bundled checker independently replays the source reference parameters and the two coexistence equilibria at a=0.8. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result is local at the predator-only boundary except for the exact global parameterization of coexistence equilibria by the prey coordinate. It does not prove a unique saddle-node for all parameters or classify global basins.

title: Exact prey-invasion threshold and the hidden saddle branch in a herd predator-prey model
